paraphrase: Victory to Cintāmaṇi, my guru, and to Somagiri; victory to Kṛṣṇa of the peacock-feather crown, whose lotus feet are the wish-fulfilling tree on which the maiden Victory (jaya-śrī) enjoys the relish of choosing her husband.
notes: The opening verse honours the courtesan Cintāmaṇi as a guru (tradition); wording approximate.
